frequency_question: How often do successfully negotiated transboundary river water frameworks meet formal criteria of a signed treaty or official MOU within the designated pre-expiration window?
membership_rule: Members are bilateral water-sharing agreements whose predecessors had fixed expiration dates; excluded are domestic water acts and multilateral treaties without explicit bilateral river allocation mandates.

cases.name: Lesotho Highlands Water Project Treaty (South Africa-Lesotho 1986)
Revised Protocol on Shared Watercourse Systems (SADC 2000)
Meghna and Ganges framework discussions/renewals (regional subset)

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named; believed to capture the primary major interstate water treaty successor instruments of this scale
known_gaps: Minor technical amendments and unpublicized protocol extensions are excluded due to lack of major press verification.
skeleton: Total successfully concluded transboundary water treaty renewals or successors vs attempted formal renewals in modern state practice
multiplier: 6 hits out of 6 documented comparable formal state renewals where substantive alignment was reached
validity_reason: Bilateral treaty-making standards and formal diplomatic signing protocols evolve slowly over decades.
